class: Selected custom dropdown answer remains part of its label
symptom: A saved No on Personal Information was reported as a blank required question after resume.
site: Church Mutual ADP Senior Network Engineer application 548, supervised continuation 25–26 October 2026
root_cause: The parser separated nested placeholders from button labels but did not separate committed values.
why_tests_missed: Placeholder coverage did not include a saved selected value with a matching preceding field label.
fix: Separate a nested suffix value only when it is a placeholder or the remaining button label matches explicit preceding field context.
prevention: Retain portal-shaped regression fixtures, inspect every repeated record, verify committed values and preserve submission and personal-answer gates.
